subject.title: feat(googlechat): support Application Default Credentials for outbound auth

question: Should Google Chat `serviceAccountAdc` be allowed to use google-auth-library/gcp-metadata metadata-server requests outside the plugin's guarded Google auth transport, or must this PR add an OpenClaw-owned guard before merge?
rationale: The implementation is mechanically coherent, but accepting direct metadata-server ADC for a channel auth path is a security-boundary and product-policy choice automation should not make.

options.title: Require a metadata guard
options.body: Ask for focused code/tests that route or constrain Compute metadata ADC access before the new config key can merge.

options.title: Accept opt-in metadata ADC
options.body: Record maintainer/security approval that `serviceAccountAdc: true` intentionally permits google-auth-library's standard metadata ADC path for Google Chat outbound auth.

options.title: Pause Google Chat ADC
options.body: Defer or close this feature until OpenClaw has a broader channel/provider ADC policy.

recommendation.title: Require a metadata guard
recommendation.body: Ask for focused code/tests that route or constrain Compute metadata ADC access before the new config key can merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal is on the Google Chat guarded-auth transport and account-resolution code touched by this review.
